review_scope: Final scientific reading of completed Task26a saved report; no resampling, producer/model execution, raw-input audit or numerical rerun in this review.

findings.finding: Complete admitted saved rows reproduce the operational batch-layout disagreement: primary 32.291666666666664 pp and positive paired-bootstrap interval.
findings.scope: Independent unblinded saved-record arithmetic; no new model replay or causal proof.

findings.finding: Canonical first-integer disagreement and raw-text disagreement differ. Heldout bf16 canonical/text counts are 54/68, 8/26, and 0/5 at log10(T)=0,.2,.4.
Primary paired sign flips have 0/10000 exceedances; raw Monte Carlo p is zero and plus-one p is 1/10001. The original inline RNG implementation is unavailable.
The greedy comparator is forced32 tokens plus cue plus8 answer tokens, without EOS stopping. Both precisions have 0/96 heldout accuracy. It is not ordinary greedy decoding accuracy.
T=1 deliberate-kick growth median is .033011474309378244, but individual values span -.12687039525407393 to .24040185753056742. A claim of growth bounded by .03 is false.
All54 deliberate-kick comparisons preserve canonical answers. One T=1, delta1e-4, problem3 row changes trailing text while both canonical answers remain63.

The96 frozen heldout indices contain95 unique ordered and94 unique unordered additions, a development overlap, a distractor overlap, and one earlier unidentified heldout smoke instance. No posthoc deduplication.
Full original state trajectories and answer-token IDs are unavailable; exact trajectory/readout flags inherit reviewed source. Historical remote model-byte identity is not reconstructed.
Finite growing-context perturbations do not identify an asymptotic exponent, exclude other amplification mechanisms, or attribute the layout effect to or away from autonomous-loop chaos.
All saved-field consistency checks pass;56 exposed producer comparisons retain34 nonzero numeric differences, primarily rounded quantities or stated statistical conventions, not34 scientific errors.

conventions.rng: PCG64(0) independently reset for each endpoint bootstrap/sign-flip
conventions.signflip: inclusive absolute half-unit integer sums; plus-one and raw p retained
conventions.identity: trajectory equality is a reported source flag, not independent raw trajectory/token proof
conventions.mechanism_pooling: 18 dependent perturbation observations per temperature; six problem units

scope_limits: Own parsing/statistics of complete saved records, no producer/model execution or new generation.
Canonical integer disagreement is primary; saved answers_differ is raw-text disagreement.
All96 frozen problem indices retained, including source-known duplicates/overlaps and one previously smoke-tested held-out instance of unidentified index.
Eight development instances are not held-out endpoints; mechanism contains six problem units with three dependent perturbations per temperature.
Separate seed0 PCG64 bootstrap/sign-flip; linear quantiles; plus-one and raw p retained. Producer inline RNG code unavailable.
Original full trajectory and answer token IDs unavailable; exact trajectory and hard-token flags remain reviewed-source claims.
BF16 soft distances are on float32 expected embeddings before bf16 input cast; no post-cast state-distance reconstruction.
Forced32 greedy tokens plus cue plus8 answer tokens is the comparator, not early-stop greedy accuracy.
Growing context differs from fixed one-slot autonomous map; finite operational effect does not establish chaos attribution.
Producer numerical summary exposed before replay; no claim of blinded validation or independently reconstructed historical remote model bytes.
